Question

Wording 1: survey years 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004

The highest grade completed as of the survey date (edited). NOTE: This round-specific variable has been converted to a cumulative version, which includes data across all interivew rounds regardless of interview status. Cumulative variables have a "survey round" of XRND (across rounds). The cumulative version of this variable can be found by searching for the same question name, replacing CV_ with CVC_.

Wording 2: survey years 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009

The highest grade completed as of the survey date. NOTE: This round-specific variable has been converted to a cumulative version, which includes data across all interivew rounds regardless of interview status. Cumulative variables have a "survey round" of XRND (across rounds). The cumulative version of this variable can be found by searching for the same question name, replacing CV_ with CVC_.

Wording 3: survey years 2010, 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023
